name: Relationship wall: live thread
when: The voice walks along a chain of three characters, left to right: a light runs from the first to the second, then to the third, and the camera follows it. It plays on the footage under it, heavily blurred, warmed and darkened (`ground`; validated on a bar at dusk). It ends on a cut.
anchor: The light reaches the middle card on its name (`at2`) and the right card on its name (`at3`); the wall is on screen, unlit, from the scene's start.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.name1: left card's name, 16 characters at most
vars.photo1: left card's portrait in the project's assets/ (shown 4:5, framed on its upper third: the face goes there)
vars.name2: middle card's name, 16 characters at most
vars.name3: right card's name, 16 characters at most
vars.link1: the label above the left string (between cards 1 and 2), 14 characters at most (the validated "Crossed paths?" is the widest that clears the cards); empty = no label
vars.kind1: confirmed (solid string) or rumoured (dashed string); default confirmed
vars.link2: the label above the right string (between cards 2 and 3), 14 characters at most; empty = no label
vars.at2: seconds after the start: when the light reaches the middle card (its name); at least 0.8
vars.at3: seconds after the start: when the light reaches the right card (its name); at least 1.53 s after at2
vars.out: seconds after the start: the scene's end, on a cut; at least 1.53 s after at3 (the camera has pulled back by then)

changed: The light runs each string in 15 frames instead of 22 and 24, arriving on the same frames as validated (f36 and f82): it waits a little longer on the pin before it leaves. Each part lands in 0.5 s. The cards' names, photos, labels, link kinds and the two arrival times are values. Photos are framed at 50 % 30 % (the validated Real Dimez still used 30 % 30 % on a landscape crop).
